name: photometry-units
description: Correct lighting math from public CIE data: lux, foot-candles, lumens, candela and nits with stated geometry; irradiance to illuminance from a spectrum (V(λ), 683.002 lm/W); CIE 1931 xy, u'v', CCT and Duv with a refusal when |Duv| > 0.05; CIE 224 / TM-30 Rf and Rg; spectrum CSV parsing; SI formatting like '550 nm'. Checked against CIE reference values. No keys, runs offline.
